verdict: Confirmed target leakage. The suspicious r2 = 1.0 is explained by two derived columns that are near-perfect transformations of the target: log_target_v2 (Spearman ρ = 0.998993270993271) and near_target_proxy (Pearson r = 0.998736261844771). All other features show |correlation| < 0.05, i.e. no genuine predictive signal, so a perfect fit is only achievable through leakage. The 0.0 perfect_match_rate indicates the leak is not an exact row-wise copy but a monotone/near-identical reconstruction of the target, which still trivially reproduces the target and inflates R² to 1.0.
